info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to sing, to make an indistinct sound, to speak inarticulately

examples: 'tatra haMsAH plavAH krOYcAH sArasAScEva rAGava. valgusvarA vikUjanti' (rA0 3.76.7). nAnA vASyanta ityarTaH. viSabdo nAnArTe.
'eza kroSati dAtyUhastaM SiKI pratikUjati' (rA0 2.56.9). pratikUjati dAtyUhaM sparDamAnaH kUjati.
'paryakUji sarujeva taruRyAstAralolavalayena kareRa' (sA0 da0). paryakUji parito guYjitam, sarvato virutam.
